انجرفت (form VII)
# اِنْجَرَفْتُ (injaraftu) /in.d͡ʒa.raf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْجَرَفَ (injarafa)
# اِنْجَرَفْتَ (injarafta) /in.d͡ʒa.raf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْجَرَفَ (injarafa)
# اِنْجَرَفْتِ (injarafti) /in.d͡ʒa.raf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْجَرَفَ (injarafa)
# اِنْجَرَفَتْ (injarafat) /in.d͡ʒa.ra.fat/: thir
